feature: Native mean-water triangle queries for dense wave domains
status: Accepted source and native helper updates. No export, APK or delivery archive; existing private engine/PCK and installed Android QA app reused.

implementation.dispatch: Only the existing cache_mean opt-in uses WaterSurfaceKernel when present. --ei-script-water-surface or older/absent native libraries retain the unchanged script triangle cache. Initialization rejection also retains that fallback.
implementation.ownership: One RefCounted per admitted cached sector. Script still owns discovery, bucket order, weak node/mesh identity, and the 16-sector LRU. Native geometry uses shared packed arrays; owned vectors contain decoded material bytes, lazy posed vertices and ready bytes. Main thread only; no scene, navigation, GPU or worker references.
implementation.math: Same float32 vector/cross boundaries, float64 scalar expression order, barycentric tolerances, highest surface and first equal-height owner. Lazy vertex offset/transform evaluation follows frame epochs; lava flags remain live. Native arithmetic is cheap enough to omit the script per-triangle cache.
implementation.unchanged: Posed query loop and wave preparation, shaders, navigation, domain admission, solver, graphics presets, independent cloud controls, protocol, .8/.9 fixes.

profile.scope: Instrumented call/stage counts, not clean timing comparisons; wrappers add overhead. Corrected fixture uses the full c797d6f Surface and Field.

cost.scope: CPU domain method, including constructor and sector work for fresh fields. Two fresh-process paired ABBA runs per platform; four before and four after values per map/category. Not GPU cost, whole-game FPS, map load or complete water-level callback.

platforms.desktop: Linux AMD Ryzen 5950X, headless CPU; GPU oracle uses RTX3090 Ti

cached_followup.scope: The short broad fixture shows cached medians 0.17–0.31 ms slower on Android. Cached calls issue no triangle queries. A separate 32-round ABBA/BAAB alternating run after eight warm-up rounds confirms exact data and no sector visits; medians differ by 0.032–0.044 ms (about 1%) on Android, 0.0065–0.018 ms on Linux. No cached-path speedup is claimed. Raw earlier values are retained.

memory.scope: Optional cache element payload only, excluding dictionary/allocator/RefCounted overhead. Existing script posed/ready buffers are unchanged. Native vectors use 14 bytes per mesh vertex on these builds, replacing 45 script bytes per allocated triangle. The LRU/clear/mesh replacement/surface retirement controls release native owners.

validation.coverage: Synthetic overlapping/degenerate/sliver/negative cases; 3,528 randomized queries with 2,928 hits per native contract run; rotated/mirrored/scaled transforms, live lava, levels and same/next-frame caches; invalid native input admission; 20-sector LRU eviction and ownership; both forced and absent-library fallbacks; base zones 1/11/8 and LiA 1/10/26 exact domains; native and scalar-worker field lifetimes.
validation.render_scope: Five held states each on Linux Compatibility, Android Compatibility and Android Mobile. Full old/new Surface sources; cache_mean enabled, with native-positive controls for waves-off and mean-offset. All 15 arrays of 4,096 expected float32 heights and 15 CPU/GPU error/coverage-image pairs are exact. These are height agreement images, not whole-scene appearance captures.

build.scope: Three local helper compilations only. Existing desktop executable/PCK copied unchanged, with the complete new Linux helper beside them. Android loads the new Surface class through a supported private GDExtension adapter; domain/solver runs also load the previously qualified two-class water adapter. The installed helper/app remain unchanged. This does not establish complete-current-source package acceptance.
build.windows_scope: Cross-compilation and static dependency checks only. This DLL now also includes WaterCurrentKernel and WaterWaveKernel, which were absent from its previous binary. Native Windows runtime and physical-device acceptance remain open; class-name presence is not runtime validation.
build.compiler_policy: Godot 4.7 API / template_release / C++17 / Release / -ffp-contract=off for helper and godot-cpp. Android NDK 29.0.14206865, API24, arm64-v8a, c++_static. Windows MinGW x86_64 with static C++/GCC runtime.
